#### List:

- Gastric secretions
- Phases: cephalic, gastric, intestinal
- Table of source, product and release stimulus

#### Gastric secretions:

+----------------+---------------------------------+
| Into the lumen | - Water                         |
|                | - HCl and IF                    |
|                | - Pepsinogen and gastric lipase |
|                | - HCO~3~ and mucus              |
+----------------+---------------------------------+
| Into blood     | - Gastrin                       |
|                | - Histamine                     |
|                | - Somatostatin                  |
+----------------+---------------------------------+

#### Phases: 

*Cephalic:*

+--------------+-----------------------------+------------------------------------+-------------+
|              | **Pathway**                 | **Stimulus**                       | **Effect**  |
+==============+=============================+====================================+=============+
| - Enteric NS |                             |                                    |             |
+--------------+-----------------------------+------------------------------------+-------------+
| - PSNS       | CNX → ↑local release of ACh | Sight, smell, anticipation of food | ↑secretions |
+--------------+-----------------------------+------------------------------------+-------------+
| - SNS        | T5-L1 via coeliac plexus    | Anxiety, pain, exercise            |             |
+--------------+-----------------------------+------------------------------------+-------------+
| - Hormones   |                             |                                    | See later   |
+--------------+-----------------------------+------------------------------------+-------------+

*Gastric:*

+-----------------------+------------------------------+---------------------------------+--------------------+
|                       | **Pathway**                  | **Stimulus**                    | **Effect**         |
+=======================+==============================+=================================+====================+
| - Enteric NS          | Meissner’s submucosal plexus | Luminal macronutrient           | ↑local ACh release |
+-----------------------+------------------------------+---------------------------------+--------------------+
| - PSNS                | As above                     | Rest, food                      | ↑local ACh release |
+-----------------------+------------------------------+---------------------------------+--------------------+
| - SNS                 | As above                     | Anxiety, pain, exercise, labour | ↓local ACh release |
+-----------------------+------------------------------+---------------------------------+--------------------+
| - Hormones (see next) |                              |                                 | See later          |
+-----------------------+------------------------------+---------------------------------+--------------------+

*Intestinal:*

+---------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------------+
|               | **Pathway**                             | **Stimulus**                                   | **Effect**          |
+===============+=========================================+================================================+=====================+
| - Enteric NS: | Enterogastric reflex                    | Duodenal macronutrients, H+, ↑osmo, distension | ↓gastric secretions |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------------+
| - PSNS        | As above (+ superior mesenteric plexus) |                                                |                     |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------------+
| - SNS         | As above (+ superior mesenteric plexus) |                                                |                     |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------------+
| - Hormones    | See next                                |                                                | See later           |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------------+

#### Secretions table

+------------------+---------------------+-----------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| **Cell**         | **Product**         | **Release stimulus**  | **Effect**                                      |
+==================+=====================+=======================+=================================================+
| Chief cell       | Pepsinogen → pepsin | ↓ gastric pH          | Proteolysis (pepsin)                            |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  | Gastric lipase      | ↓ intestinal pH       | Lipolysis                                       |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  |                     | ACh (CNX)             |                                                 |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  |                     | Gastrin               |                                                 |
+------------------+---------------------+-----------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| Parietal cell    | HCl                 | Gastric peptides      | 1.  Proteolysis                                 |
|                  |                     |                       | 2.  Activate pepsin                             |
|                  | IF                  | Duo peptides          | 3.  Kill microbes                               |
|                  |                     |                       | 4.  Reduce iron to Fe2+                         |
|                  |                     | ACh (CNX)             | 5.  Stimulate pancreatic and biliary secretions |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  |                     | Gastrin               | Complex B~12~ (IF)                              |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  |                     | Histamine             |                                                 |
+------------------+---------------------+-----------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| G cell           | Gastrin             | ACh → GRP             | ↑parietal cell activity                         |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  |                     | Gastric distension    |                                                 |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  |                     | Gastric peptides      |                                                 |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  |                     | Caffeine, alcohol     |                                                 |
+------------------+---------------------+-----------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| D cell           | Somatostatin        | Gastric acid          | ↓ chief cell activity                           |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  |                     | Duodenal acid         | ↓ parietal cell activity                        |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  |                     | GIP, CGRP             |                                                 |
+------------------+---------------------+-----------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| E cell           | Histamine           | ACh                   | ↑parietal cell activity                         |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  |                     | Gastrin               |                                                 |
+------------------+---------------------+-----------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| Mucous neck cell | Mucous              | Constitutive (PGE~2~) | Physical barrier                                |
|                  |                     |                       |                                                 |
|                  | HCO~3~^-^           | Irritation            | Chemical buffer                                 |
+------------------+---------------------+-----------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
